summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Bidinn Sales CRM new features: Date range filter for agent reports, 30-day auto-reset job, bulk lead export to CSV, and user deactivation/reactivation/password reset. All backend APIs (52/53 tests passed, 1 skipped) and frontend UI features working correctly.
passed_tests: User Management - Non-admin cannot toggle status
User Management - Non-admin cannot reset password
Authentication - Sales rep login still works
Frontend - Reports page loads with date range filter
Frontend - Date preset dropdown works (All Time, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, Last Quarter, Custom)
Frontend - Custom date pickers appear when filter selected
Frontend - Agent performance table displays correctly
Frontend - Leads page Export button works
Frontend - Team page loads with user management
Frontend - User actions menu shows Reset Password and Deactivate options
Frontend - Reset Password dialog opens correctly

success_rate.backend: 100% (52/53 tests passed, 1 skipped due to fixture dependency)

seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing (TEST_user_mgmt_* prefix)

date_range_filter.details: Reports page has date range filter with presets (All Time, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, Last Quarter, Custom). Custom date pickers appear when filter is selected. Data updates correctly based on filter.

auto_reset_job.details: API endpoint /api/admin/run-auto-reset works correctly. Admin-only access enforced. Job resets leads inactive for 30+ days.

csv_export.details: Export button on Leads page triggers CSV download. Supports CSV and XLSX formats. Filters (status, source) work with export.

user_deactivation.details: Admin can deactivate/reactivate users via Team page. Confirmation dialog shown. Self-deactivation prevented.

password_reset.details: Admin can reset user passwords via Team page dialog. Minimum 6 character validation enforced.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 and P1 features have been implemented and tested. Backend is Express.js/TypeScript with MySQL. The auto-reset job is scheduled to run daily at midnight. User management features (deactivate/reactivate/password reset) are admin-only. Date range filter on Reports page supports presets and custom date ranges. CSV export on Leads page supports filtering by status and source.
